messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 Pager — metering-aggregator mismatch detected. Token counts for a subset of tenants increased ~2x between 10:12–11:05 UTC. Possible consumer windowing bug. Paged: platform-oncall, eng-ml, billing-team.

sam (oncall-platform): getting this alert now. seeing a spike in the aggregation job logs. tagging maya for infra help.

maya (oncall-eng): on it — I can access the aggregator consumer logs. initial glance: there are repeated commits for the same sequence ids during a brief leader failover.

alex (eng-ml): which pipeline? kv-aggregator-v2 or legacy-aggregator?

jordan (sre): looks like kv-aggregator-v2 had a leader restart around 10:10 UTC from the node avion-03. broker log shows a rejoin and consumer group rebalance.

sam (oncall-platform): evidence: sample query showing per-tenant token count diff:
```
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= '2026-11-02T10:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-11-02T11:30:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
-- tenant x: expected ~12,300 tokens, observed ~24,100
```

maya (oncall-eng): uploading a grep of commit ids: looks like duplicates because the consumer processed some messages twice after rebalance; offsets were committed but the checkpointing handshake missed a heartbeat.

alex (eng-ml): do we have a quick fix? rollback to legacy aggregator or kill the rebalance?

jordan (sre): short-term mitigation: pause auto-billing exports and mark the billing window as "investigating" so downstream billing doesn't finalize. I can flip the flag in the billing pipeline config.

sam (oncall-platform): please do that now — priority is to prevent incorrect invoices.

jordan (sre): done. billing export paused at 11:22 UTC. billing-team-bot notified.

billing-team-bot: Billing export paused (manual hold) by jordan (sre). Note: no customer invoices have been sent for the affected window yet.

lina (customer-success): pinging customer success — we should prepare a hold message for major accounts if they ask. Are there known customers impacted?

alex (eng-ml): I've run a dedupe pass on a sample partition. simple heuristic: dedupe by (tenant_id, event_id) — duplicates present for ~12% of events in the window. I can generate a corrected counts table, but we need consensus on whether to apply it automatically.

maya (oncall-eng): root cause seems to be a race in the consumer group checkpoint when leader flips during a short network hiccup. fix plan: patch consumer to use stronger commit protocol + add idempotent guard for event_id. Hotfix branch ready.

sam (oncall-platform): plan: 1) keep billing exports paused, 2) run a safe dedupe script to produce corrected counts for affected tenants, 3) deploy hotfix to aggregator with canary on a single partition, 4) rerun reconciliation and unpause exports after verification.

jordan (sre): assigning tasks: maya — deploy hotfix canary and watch offsets; alex — produce corrected counts for top 50 tenants and sanity-check; lina — draft tentative customer note (internal) describing hold and next steps; sam — coordinate with billing ops to schedule credits if needed.

maya (oncall-eng): canary deployed to partition p-17 at 11:40 UTC. offsets look stable. no duplicate commits observed on canary.

alex (eng-ml): corrected counts table ready for sample tenants: storing as `metering.reconciled_1832501234`. sample diff: tenant alpha: observed 48,200 -> reconciled 24,050 (50% duplicates). attaching snippet.

sam (oncall-platform): good. what's the ETA to reconcile whole window?

alex (eng-ml): full window backfill will take ~45m to compute offline and 20m to validate.

jordan (sre): keep timeline conservative — say 90m to full reconciliation and verification.

lina (customer-success): drafting internal note now. will include that we paused billing exports and will proactively credit customers if any overage flags were raised.

billing-team-bot: Noted: billing exports are on hold. Flagged affected tenants for manual review in billing ops.

maya (oncall-eng): hotfix merged to main at 12:05 UTC and scheduled rollout. incremental rollout to 3 nodes first.

sam (oncall-platform): handoff: I'm rounding to the afternoon oncall at 12:30. maya will be primary for tech; jordan will own billing coordination; alex owns reconciliation.

maya (oncall-eng): taking ownership for the next shift. will update this thread after full reconciliation completes.

jordan (sre): once recon completes, we will: 1) run diff audit, 2) unpause billing export behind a toggle, 3) generate credit proposals for any customers with >1% overcount.

alex (eng-ml): reconciliation finished at 12:40 UTC (reconciled table available). quick audit shows 97% of tenants had <0.5% change; 3% had >10% (likely heavy burst patterns).

lina (customer-success): prepping a customer-facing FAQ and a targeted list for top 20 accounts.

jordan (sre): unpaused billing export in staging, ran end-to-end smoke, looks good. will coordinate with billing ops to re-enable in production at 13:20 UTC behind a safety toggle.

sam (oncall-platform): handoff complete. leaving notes for post-incident doc: cause = consumer checkpoint race during leader failover; impact = temporary doubled counts in a narrow window for ~3% of tenants; mitigations = billing hold, dedupe/reconciliation, hotfix deployed, credits queued; follow-up = rollback guard, e2e test for rebalance, billing runbook update.

maya (oncall-eng): follow-up action items created in #eng-runtime and assigned. linking incident ID INC-20261102-3 in the postmortem.

lina (customer-success): will proactively message affected customers and offer manual recon results + credits where applicable.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20261102-3 status: Mitigated — action items created. If further regressions occur, page platform-oncall.

sam (oncall-platform): closing thread for active mitigation. please add any outstanding notes here and I'll include them in the postmortem.
